name: Saint Veyra Capital
summary: Saint Veyra is the first capital hub: stained glass, black roadstone, guild halls, training courts, Concord paperwork, faction envoys, and the first road out. It should feel social, ceremonial, bureaucratic, and slightly ominous.

name: Hearthmere Fields
summary: Hearthmere Fields is the starter road zone with farms, pilgrims, ash-gray wolf trails, field rests, road patrol concerns, and the route toward the Road Shrine of Little Dawn.

name: Road Shrine of Little Dawn
summary: The Road Shrine of Little Dawn is a protected road shrine watched by Shrinekeeper Olla. It gates the Pilgrim Trial Cryptlet and teaches road discipline, shrine permission, bell signs, and patient party pacing.

name: Pilgrim Trial Cryptlet
summary: Pilgrim Trial Cryptlet is the first training dungeon. It teaches party behavior, basic packs, object counterplay, movement lanes, hidden memory, Bellgrave Warden telegraphs, wipe recap, and source-driven reward discipline.

name: Bulwark Starter Class
summary: Bulwark is the first playable class. It protects the party through lanes, Guard Stance, Shield Oath, threat control, patience, and clear calls before pulls.

name: Starter Social Cast
summary: Starter social cast: Pilgrim Renn is nervous and helpful; Olla is dry and devotional; Edrin is a calm healer; Tallowwick is witty DPS with object duty; Mothknife is a terse scout; Ysabet Cord is the guild contract clerk who dislikes vague rewards.

name: Canon Guardrails
summary: Canon rules: no ghost loot, no invented permanent gear, no monetization, no accounts/backend claims, no full MMO scope leap. Unfinished rewards must be staged or source-checked.
